_meta.purpose: S3·U1 volunteer-team fixture (FR-D6-1, FEATURE_D6_VOLUNTEER_TEAMS). Each row is fed through the REAL makeVolunteerTeamFields factory (src/application/aggregate/volunteer-team.ts), so the callsign pattern/maxLength (READ from schemas/d6-volunteer-team.schema.json), the non-negative headcount tally and the closed availability enum all hold on the fixture itself.
_meta.provenance: HAND-SEEDED demo teams. There is no volunteer-registry source adapter in BEACON; GET /volunteer-teams serves this as MOCK and says so in provenance[] (Art. XVI).
_meta.privacy: Art. XIV / ADR-035 §4 — a team is a UNIT: a callsign, a headcount tally and capability tags. No roster, no member, no name, no contact anywhere in this file.
_meta.coverage: all three availability states, a zero-headcount stood-up unit, and a team with no skills tags — so every optional render path is non-empty somewhere
